title: "SFI Centres for Research Training"

description: "Named PhD supervisor in the Foundations of Data Science and Genomics Data Science SFI Centres for Research Training."
categories: [news]
---

I am a named PhD supervisor in two **Centres for Research Training (CRTs)** funded by **Science Foundation Ireland**:

- [SFI CRT in Foundations of Data Science](https://www.data-science.ie/)
- [SFI CRT in Genomics Data Science](https://genomicsdatascience.ie/)

Both programmes offer fully funded cohort-based PhD training across data science, statistical methodology, and genomics. Follow the links above for programme and application details.
